Name: Neko Abigail - Anime Portraits
Author: NguoiVoDanh
Description:
The original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14]Portrait Anime Styled[/url] mod was created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/toon1256]toon1256[/url] and it compatible with the latest version 1.6 and up.

[How to Install (Content Patcher Version) ]

All you need to do is download this mod, extract it to get the images, and place them in the “assets” folder of the original mod or any other portrait mod you have.
